title: Licence audit script that fails on a copyleft dependency
context: Common Studio is an open, public-domain music production studio in software, written new in Python with permissive dependencies and released under the Unlicense. This task is part of its first milestones: the licence-clean spine that every later gate depends on. The owner's private reference pipeline may be consulted for ideas only; no text, configuration value, arrangement source, skill or asset from it may be copied, and every name, format and value is authored new.
objective: Write a licence audit script under scripts/ that reads the project's installed dependency tree and fails when any package carries a copyleft licence, and wire it into CI.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-10: The audit script lists every dependency's licence, exits non-zero when one is copyleft (GPL, LGPL, AGPL and similar) and zero otherwise, and a test using a copyleft fixture makes it fail.
AC-10: The script runs in CI, and a CI run passes on the project's own tree.
Tests pass; the commit is DCO signed-off.
output: A pull request adding the licence audit script under scripts/, its copyleft fixture and test, and the CI step.
